host.affinity: First eight listed physical CPU IDs for Base and QuarantineEqualsProposer; all 32 for Retry and RenewRetry. Guest default clock and turbo. One fresh process per cell.

method: Original passing configurations with all published properties and the state constraint; no model edits. One whole-process measurement per mode. Eight-worker controls used the pinned TLC rolling jar and JRE 17 with -Xmx32g -XX:+UseParallelGC -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=8. Core used nominal TLC profile, fp 0, seed 0. Authors used a different TLC version, fingerprint and host. All counts are fingerprint-based.
reproduce: For the eight-worker controls, from tla/spec at the source revision: dive check PaxosLeaseChecked.tla --config CFG --workers 8 --fp 0 --seed 0 --compat=tlc --output json. For TLC use -workers 8 -fp 0 -seed 0 -config CFG PaxosLeaseChecked.tla with the specified JVM.

tlc_build: TLC2 2026.10.06.014338 (94d0c50), Eclipse Adoptium JRE 17.0.20.1, MSBDiskFPSet and DiskStateQueue
retry_method: Two independent isolated r7i.16xlarge instances in us-east-1a with default guest frequency policy. Pinned to the same 32 physical cores (one logical CPU/core). Each process had an external 448 GiB cgroup, no swap, and a four-hour check budget. Ordinary Core used --compat=tlc --workers 32 --fp 0 --seed 0 --max-memory 400g --time-limit 14400s on a 160 GiB gp3 root. Pinned TLC used -Xmx192g -XX:+UseParallelGC -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=32 -workers 32 -seed 0 -fp 0 with external timeout 14400s and 1 TiB gp3 (16000 IOPS / 1000 MiB/s) for its disk-backed queues. Actual terminal results and GNU time measurements are distinct from the author’s eight-worker TLC 2.19 numbers.

symbolic_retry_probe.scope: Input-admission observations only. The authors’ constraints and assumptions were preserved in all reported performance runs.

Each process had an external 448 GiB cgroup, no swap, and a four-hour check budget. Ordinary Core used --compat=tlc --workers 32 --fp 0 --seed 0 --max-memory 400g --time-limit 14400s on a 160 GiB gp3 root. Pinned TLC used -Xmx192g -XX:+UseParallelGC -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=32 -workers 32 -seed 0 -fp 0 with external timeout 14400s and 1 TiB gp3 (16000 IOPS / 1000 MiB/s) for its disk-backed queues. RenewRetry used the same runner on two fresh instances. Actual terminal results and GNU time measurements are distinct from the author’s eight-worker TLC 2.19 numbers.

symbolic_refinement.interpreter: packaged CPython 3.11 with dd.cudd on Linux
symbolic_refinement.command: dive check --strategy symbolic PaxosLeaseChecked.tla --config CFG --type-invariant TypeOK --refine-domains --max-memory 24g --time-limit SECONDS --output json
symbolic_refinement.platform: Dedicated r7i.4xlarge, us-east-1a, one physical core via taskset, default clock, 32 GiB cgroup, zero swap. GNU time covers supervisor, domain-learning passes and all binding. Base budget 900 s, quarantine and Retry 1800 s. One observation per cell.

rows.memory_scope: Single live ps RSS sample of the largest process. The supervisor killed the entire process group on timeout. GNU time did not account for that worker’s terminal high-water mark.

symbolic_refinement.interpretation: Cluster the sparse set membership bits with local-state fields indexed by the same participant. Each learning pass starts from the original Init. A constrained-out target remains an invariant obligation. Counts in successful symbolic rows are exact over the represented sets. Explicit reference counts use fingerprint stores.
symbolic_refinement.rejected_probe: Precomposing the complete state constraint with every simultaneous update made the compilation intermediates expensive. The released positive pass instead streams each action image and intersects the target constraint before retaining the next frontier.
symbolic_refinement.initial_ablation: On the shared workstation, the ungrouped generic Base run completed in 185.42 s. For the quarantine case at depth 18 the ungrouped admitted layer had about 3.87 million BDD nodes, compared with about 0.88 million after participant ordering.

prototype.host: EC2 r7i.4xlarge, us-east-1a. One non-sibling physical core 7, 5 GiB per-process virtual memory limit, 900s whole-process deadline. Other experimental single-core searches on separate cores shared the host memory and last-level cache. Single observation per input/arm; GNU time reports wall and maximum child/process RSS.
prototype.source: Original PaxosLeaseChecked.tla and original Base / QuarantineEqualsProposer CFGs pinned above. A private worker transferred only coordinate names, then rebound and checked each complete input. Both warm trials seeded from Base-cold. Cold/warm on a given configuration must agree on counts, depth, and verdict. Cross-configuration hints can introduce dormant coordinates.

installed_candidate.host: Dedicated EC2 c7i.4xlarge, us-east-1a, search pinned to physical CPU 0, no swap. Single ordered invocation per case, small validation checks on other cores. Earlier installed candidate before trace-file and manager lifetime fixes. Per-revision seconds are reported by the checker; native GNU time and peak RSS apply to complete invocations only.
installed_candidate.command: dive check PaxosLeaseChecked.tla --config FIRST --strategy symbolic --type-invariant TypeOK --refine-domains --time-limit 2400s --max-memory 6g --output json; session adds --recheck PaxosLeaseChecked.tla PaxosLeaseBase.cfg --recheck PaxosLeaseChecked.tla PaxosLeaseQuarantineEqualsProposer.cfg

retained_refined_closure_edits.method: Separate fresh installed CLI sessions, sequentially on the same physical core of an isolated c7i.4xlarge. Each session checks the original configuration, repeats it, adds EmissionBound, then adds the false EmptyNetwork obligation. Peak RSS is GNU time's maximum for the session. Row seconds come from the checker. Each false result is independently replayed.

transition_witness_edits.method: Paired sessions on an isolated c7i.4xlarge, both pinned to physical core 0; small independently pinned functional checks shared the host during Base. Same native checker and exporter, compared retained closure from before this change against the candidate worker. Every arm begins cold and edits the original released module through a wrapper. Elapsed seconds per revision from the worker, whole-process time and RSS from GNU time.
transition_witness_edits.recipe: In a copy of PaxosLeaseChecked.tla renamed WithIdle.tla or WithTick.tla, insert EditedNext == Next \/ UNCHANGED vars or EditedNext == Next \/ Tick before the module terminator, and define EditedSpec == Init /\ [][EditedNext]_vars. In the edited CFG replace SPECIFICATION Spec by SPECIFICATION EditedSpec; keep every other setting. Run original, WithIdle, WithTick, original, in that order via --recheck.
transition_witness_edits.command: dive check PaxosLeaseChecked.tla --strategy symbolic --type-invariant TypeOK --refine-domains --config ORIGINAL --recheck WithIdle.tla EDITED --recheck WithTick.tla EDITED --recheck PaxosLeaseChecked.tla ORIGINAL --time-limit 3600s --max-memory 7g --output json
transition_witness_edits.validation: Independent cold and explicit comparisons on 27 scalar revisions, eight orbit-counting cases and a seeded 44-revision multigraph with a separate breadth-first enumerator. Covered excluded emissions, shortest validated counterexamples, deadlock, reachable shortcuts, domain growth, multiplicity and changed Init.

symbolic_variable_order_trials.method: Instrumented source-checkout experiments on one isolated r7i.4xlarge, one process pinned per physical core; concurrent runs share memory bandwidth, cache and package power. Trials use the original module and unchanged CFGs. Each logs decision-diagram sizes at layer entry before evaluating invariants or the image. The final logged layer is a progress observation. GNU time RSS in a timeout may omit a killed worker and is not a reliable peak for the entire process tree.
symbolic_variable_order_trials.command: dive check --strategy symbolic PaxosLeaseChecked.tla --config CFG --type-invariant TypeOK --refine-domains --time-limit {900s for Base, 7200s for Retry} --max-memory 18g --output json

orders.once: Start static and reorder once at layer 12 when frontier exceeds 2000 nodes

bounded_message_slot_trials.design: Prototype sorted, duplicate-free finite-set entries in fixed slots, coding a learned message by an integer and reserving the highest code for empty. Apply deletions before insertions. Detect overflow even for successors excluded by the state constraint.
bounded_message_slot_trials.method: Same isolated r7i.4xlarge as the order trials, taskset to physical core 6 while independent ordering experiments used other cores. Process-tree RSS from GNU time can omit a worker terminated by the supervisor. Prefix node counts correspond to entry into a layer of the last refinement pass.
bounded_message_slot_trials.reduced_change: PaxosLeaseRetry.cfg with only MaxNetwork = 4 replaced by MaxNetwork = 1.

base_capacity_diagnostic.finding: A reachable admitted source with four messages can produce an emission beyond the six-slot representation. The checker refused. The diagnostic replay distinguished overflow from an unrelated invalid encoding.
